title: Verdant Wellness — Brand Overhaul
description: A complete brand transformation for India's fastest-growing wellness startup — new identity, website, and content strategy that tripled their organic reach.
challenge: Verdant Wellness had a strong product but a fragmented brand presence — inconsistent visuals, low search visibility, and a website that didn't reflect their premium positioning.
solution: We rebuilt the brand from the ground up: new logo, visual system, and brand voice, followed by a Next.js website with a dedicated content strategy focused on wellness SEO.

process.title: Discovery
process.desc: Brand audit, competitor analysis, and stakeholder interviews to map the brand gap.

process.title: Strategy
process.desc: Defined brand positioning, target audience personas, and a unique brand narrative.

process.title: Design
process.desc: Created the full visual identity — logo, colour system, typography, and component library.

process.title: Build & Launch
process.desc: Engineered the Next.js site and deployed a 6-month SEO content plan.

title: Lumina Tech — Product Launch
description: End-to-end product launch campaign across Meta, Google, and influencer channels that generated ₹2 crore in revenue within the first month.
challenge: Lumina Tech was launching a new B2C product with aggressive revenue targets and a short 30-day window to prove market fit.
solution: We ran a full-funnel paid campaign across Meta and Google with creative direction, influencer seeding, and a dedicated landing page built for conversion.

process.title: Brief & Research
process.desc: Deep competitor and audience research to understand the whitespace and buying triggers.

process.title: Creative Dev
process.desc: Produced 40+ ad creatives across formats — statics, videos, and UGC-style content.

process.title: Campaign Launch
process.desc: Launched across Meta and Google with structured A/B tests for audiences, creatives, and bids.

process.title: Optimise & Scale
process.desc: Daily optimisation cycles scaled winning creatives 10× within 2 weeks.

title: Artisan & Co. — E-Commerce
description: Full e-commerce rebuild with custom Shopify theme, SEO overhaul, and paid media management that improved ROAS from 1.1× to 4.2×.
challenge: Artisan & Co. had a dated Shopify store and poor paid media performance — high spend, low returns.
solution: We rebuilt the Shopify theme for speed and conversion, overhauled their Google Shopping and Meta ads structure, and implemented full attribution tracking.

process.title: Audit
process.desc: Full technical and conversion audit — identified 14 critical drop-off points.

process.title: Store Rebuild
process.desc: Custom Shopify Liquid theme with performance-first architecture and conversion UX.

process.title: Ads Overhaul
process.desc: Restructured Google Shopping and Meta campaigns with proper audience segmentation.

process.title: Attribution
process.desc: Implemented GA4 + server-side tracking for full multi-channel visibility.

title: Horizon Finance — Content Strategy
description: A year-long organic content programme for a fintech brand that built a loyal community of 180,000 followers across LinkedIn and Instagram.
challenge: Horizon Finance needed to build brand trust and audience in a sceptical fintech space without relying on paid spend.
solution: We built a 12-month organic content strategy: educational long-form content, a weekly newsletter, and a social media playbook focused on LinkedIn and Instagram.

process.title: Content Audit
process.desc: Mapped the competitive landscape and found the trust and education gap in fintech content.

process.title: Playbook
process.desc: Built a 12-month editorial calendar with SEO-aligned topics and social content pillars.

process.title: Production
process.desc: Weekly long-form articles, daily LinkedIn content, and bi-weekly newsletter dispatches.

process.title: Community
process.desc: Turned content into community — comments, reposts, and DMs drove organic compounding growth.

title: Bloom Beauty — Brand Launch
description: Brand identity and social media launch for an indie beauty brand that reached 50,000 followers in its first three months.
challenge: Bloom Beauty launched with no brand presence and needed to build an audience from zero in a crowded beauty market.
solution: End-to-end brand creation — identity, packaging direction, and a content-first social launch strategy tailored for Gen-Z beauty consumers.

process.title: Brand Build
process.desc: Created identity, tone of voice, and aesthetic direction for a Gen-Z beauty audience.

process.title: Content System
process.desc: Developed repeatable content formats and a visual grid strategy for Instagram.

process.title: Launch Campaign
process.desc: Seeded 30+ micro-influencers for launch week — 400K reach in 48 hours.

process.title: Community Growth
process.desc: UGC repurposing strategy and comment engagement turned followers into advocates.

title: Nexus SaaS — Growth Programme
description: A combined SEO, content, and analytics programme for a B2B SaaS company that tripled monthly recurring revenue in under a year.
challenge: Nexus had a solid product but relied entirely on cold outbound. They needed scalable inbound growth.
solution: We built an inbound engine: a topic-cluster SEO strategy, gated lead magnets, and a dashboard to track MRR attribution by channel.

process.title: SEO Architecture
process.desc: Built a topic-cluster model across 8 core keyword verticals with 200+ target terms.

process.title: Content Engine
process.desc: 6 long-form articles/month plus supporting cluster posts optimised for intent.

process.title: Lead Magnets
process.desc: Created 4 gated tools and templates that converted organic traffic into qualified leads.

process.title: Attribution
process.desc: Custom Looker Studio dashboard connecting SEO, content, and MRR in one view.
